delivery_structure.rationale: The cadence is the delivery half of this piece's recorded experiment (style_direction): if the hypothesis is that construction teaches, the narration must let constructions COMPLETE before claiming over them — a claim spoken over a half-drawn axis is the delivery equivalent of describing instead of showing. The two construction beats are therefore the piece's designed silences (wd-02's suspension joints serve a correction; this piece's serve a construction — the function differs, the discipline is the same: every pause has a named job). Everything else at statement pace: a foundation piece declares and builds, it does not tease.

delivery_structure.value: GUIDED-CONSTRUCTION cadence over the six moves: statement pace (M1–M2) → CONSTRUCTION BEAT 1 (the axes finish drawing before positions are claimed, M3) → CONSTRUCTION BEAT 2 — the piece's longest held beat (the arrow draws and the sphere is born before the word 'direction' lands, M4) → widening at statement pace (M5) → steering performed (M6) → payoff + recall → bridge under bed only. hook_form.rationale: The foundation register: this piece DECLARES its problem. The forced problem is the one opening that makes the whole arc necessary — if words could be held as words, nothing after line 1 needs to exist; the hook's job here is necessity, not teasing. A performed cold-open was rejected (spends the opening on an effect the foundation cannot afford — its seconds belong to the failed attempt, which must be honestly tried before it fails). The viewer's question is carried internally (story_structure), not spoken as the hook: the piece answers 'what is a direction?' by construction, and a spoken question would promise an answer-by-assertion the arc refuses to give.

hook_form.value: The forced problem, stated in the first line with its stakes in the same breath: 'A computer can't hold a word. scene_decomposition.rationale: The inventory is prescribed from the architecture, not enumerated from the shipped scene: each compartment exists because a move requires a visual event, and the continuity law exists because the objective's argument is about the SAME arrow persisting across scales (word → text → context) — if the sphere were re-drawn per beat, scale would be illustrated instead of performed. The emblem is drawn (stroke construction) under the style experiment, not placed as a baked plate — the old build's sphere survives only as baked render plates, which the causal rule and the experiment both refuse. scene_decomposition.value: ONE self-contained HTML file (the MP4 renders from this file alone), decomposed into compartments that follow the six moves: C0 THE BOARD — the blueprint stage (deep blue-black, faint grid) + series furniture · C1 THE FORCED PROBLEM — a WORD chip dissolves into a growing list of number chips (M1) · C2 THE ROW — a drawn line with five slots; chips CAT 1 / CAR 2 / FISH 3 / BOAT 4 / DOG 5 settle onto it; a dashed 'relates?' link between neighbours draws, cracks, fades (M2) · C3 THE MAP — the axes draw themselves in, named (LAND↔WATER across, LIVING↔BUILT up), a readout ( __ , __ ) that fills as chips fly to their coordinates (M3) · C4 THE ARROWS + THE SPHERE — arrows draw from the origin (CAT and DOG gold, near-parallel, with a small arc; BOAT cyan, wide, with a wide arc); the wireframe sphere then draws itself around the hero arrow and PERSISTS (M4) · C5 THE SCALE — a counter races 2 → 3,072 beside the sphere; faint arrows multiply inside it; the axis names dissolve; the map recedes (M5a) · C6 THE WIDENING — three cards (A SENTENCE / AN INSTRUCTION / THE WHOLE CONTEXT) each sprout an arrow; the arrows merge into the sphere's one arrow (M5b) · C7 STEERING + THE CHECK — an INSTRUCTION card arrives and the sphere's arrow swings to a new heading; a dashed arrow leaves the sphere, turned (the model continues it); a faint drift ghost peels off the heading and is pulled back onto it (M6) · C8 THE BRIDGE CARD (the referral). Plus the standing compartments: the board/furniture, the word-animation layer (the narration's words in the picture's empty space), the audio compartment, and the in-page decision-record layer. CONTINUITY LAW OF THIS SCENE: the sphere, once born at M4, never leaves the frame — the map's hero arrow becomes its embedded arrow, and every later event (scale, widening, steering, the check) happens TO that sphere. One focal group at a time.

story_structure.rationale: Prescribed from the objective with the narrative-architecture discipline applied deliberately (the owner's wd-02 iteration-3 finding: opening promise, motivated transitions, arc, ending/recall — designed, not emergent). Every transition carries its reason: M1→M2, the cheap fix must be honestly tried before its failure means anything (a failure asserted is a claim; a failure watched is a fact). M2→M3, the failure names the exact lack — one number cannot say how two words RELATE — so the turn must supply a second dimension, nothing else. M3→M4, positions alone are still labels (a place is an address until it is read as a pointing); the arrow is drawn only once places exist to point at. M4→M5, a concept true at two numbers is stress-tested at the real scale (thousands) and at the real scope (any text) before it is spent. M5→M6, once the context itself points, pointing it deliberately IS steering — the owner's concept arrives as a consequence of the geometry, not as a new topic — and steering is incomplete without the check (the mega prompt's standing use in wd-02: the direction the work is verified against). ARC: problem → failed fix → true fix → reframe → scale → use. RECALL: M1's opening sentence returns in M6 reversed ('can't hold a word' → 'holds arrows instead'), so the viewer hears the whole journey in one sentence. No embedding jargon in the narration ('vector', 'dimension', 'embedding' are never spoken: the picture carries the geometry, the words stay plain — canon audience rule).

story_structure.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 2, 2026-10-26), derived from the phase-1 objective + the owner's direction concept (2026-10-26) + the narrative-architecture discipline (owner's wd-02 iteration-2 verdict, 2026-10-26)
story_structure.value: Six moves, prescribed from the objective: M1 THE FORCED PROBLEM — a computer can't hold a word; it can only hold numbers, so every word has to become a list of numbers. OPENING PROMISE: by the end, the viewer will have watched a word become an arrow. M2 THE FAILED ROW — give each word ONE number (cat 1, car 2, fish 3, boat 4, dog 5): the row can sort the words, but it cannot say how any two words relate. M3 THE TURN — give each word TWO numbers on two named axes (land↔water, living↔built): words take places — cat on the land side among the living, the boat low on the water. M4 THE REVEAL — draw an arrow from the start to the word: a place re-read is a direction. Cat and dog point almost the same way — that is what 'related' means in there; the boat points away. The sphere is born around the hero arrow (the emblem of a direction). M5 THE WIDENING — real models use thousands of numbers per word, learned from use, not handed names — still one arrow; and not just words: a sentence, an instruction, the whole context points too (the sphere's arrow is now the context's direction). M6 STEERING + THE CHECK (payoff + recall) — an instruction re-points the context's sphere; the model takes the direction it is given and continues it; every piece of work can be checked against that direction — on it, or drifting. The opening returns reversed: the machine can't hold a word — it holds arrows instead. A word is a direction. The question the video answers (viewer-voiced): 'ChatGPT just read my words — but what did it actually hold?'

style_direction.rationale: The mix is derived from the objective's jobs AND from the experiment directive: (a) the concept is GEOMETRY — the argument is literally a drawn figure (a row that fails, a plane that works, an arrow) — so the spine must be drawn geometry, and the 2D menu style is the one whose native material is flat drawn shape; (b) the learning claim of the piece is construction — the viewer must watch the figure being BUILT (an axis appearing is the moment 'a second number' becomes a place) — the whiteboard hand supplies draw-on construction, which neither the A59 object grammar (objects arrive whole) nor cinematic typography (words arrive) can perform; (c) the A59 spine was rejected FOR THIS PIECE as the default it has become on soa-01/wd-02: spending it here too would make three consecutive pieces one treatment — the exact un-decided sameness the experimentation directive exists to prevent; cinematic typography as spine rejected: the verdict moments here are geometric (the reveal is a drawing, not a sentence), so monumental type would decorate, not argue; collage/mix-media rejected: texture noise fights a figure whose entire meaning is line position. HELD CONSTANT (so the comparison stays readable): the word-animation grammar (entries on the media clock at spoken words, principal words accented gold), dark stage + series furniture, the pause-map discipline, ≤3 words' emphasis logic, and THE SPHERE EMBLEM ITSELF — the asset under variation is the treatment around the emblem, never the emblem.

style_direction.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 2, 2026-10-26) — a RECORDED EXPERIMENT under the owner's style-experimentation directive (2026-10-26): vary delivery + visual storytelling intentionally across episodes; menu per files/a59-motion-brief.md (#77)
style_direction.value: RECORDED EXPERIMENT (whole-style exploration, per the brief's experiment discipline). SPINE: 2D GRAPHICS — flat drawn diagram geometry (the row, the axes, the arrows, the sphere's wire) rendered as clean flat vector shapes on a deep blueprint board (blue-black, faint grid); the geometry is the picture. HAND: WHITEBOARD-style DRAW-ON CONSTRUCTION — axes, arrows, the relates-link and the sphere's wire visibly draw themselves (stroke by stroke) as the narration builds them; nothing arrives pre-drawn except the board. Palette: chalk-white construction lines; cyan for the water side / the unrelated; gold reserved for the hero arrow, relatedness, and principal words. Type is FUNCTIONAL only (labels, readouts, the word band, the payoff set plainly) — cinematic typography is deliberately NOT spent here. VARIABLES vs soa-01 (cinematic typography + A59) and wd-02 (A59 spine + cinematic verdicts): (1) a flat drawn diagram world instead of textured cutout objects on a void; (2) draw-on construction instead of keyframed object flights; (3) a blueprint register instead of the gold-on-void verdict register; (4) delivery paired to construction (delivery_structure). HYPOTHESIS: a geometry concept is learned by watching it being built — each claim lands on a completed drawing, so the reveal (a place IS a direction) is seen, not asserted; and the foundation piece reads visually distinct from the definition pieces around it. Judged later by the owner's score and restatement/retention signals; confounds named in the phase-7 record (topic, channel — flagship vs Earth One — length). Title (production step): STANDS — 'A Word Is a Direction' (the referral names the piece by it; the title is the message). Cover: the sphere frame at its birth completed (wire sphere + gold embedded arrow), cover line 'WORDS POINT.' — verified at phone size in phase-4 QA.
